proposals.title: Gender pay equity report
proposals.proponent: Arjuna Capital, on behalf of Rainer Yingling Judd
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on the company's global median gender pay gap, including associated policy, reputational, competitive, and operational risks, and risks related to recruiting and retaining female talent.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal

proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to amend proxy access bylaws so candidates need not obtain a specific percentage vote to qualify as proxy access candidates in future meetings.
